messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

message.content:
The Premier League’s all‑time assist leader is **Kevin De Bruyne**.  
He has topped the assists chart in multiple seasons (most notably 2019/20 with 20 assists) and remains the benchmark for creative playmakers in the league.
